intro.title: Ask the floor what it knows
intro.body: Everything your agents learn becomes a graph of agents, tickets and notes, on your machine. Search it by the exact words or by meaning.
intro.hint: Put an exact phrase in quotes, like "login test". Tick results to send them to an agent with a prompt.

exact.noHive: Open a hive to search its memory.
